name: Ca tram song Son
summary: Grass carp from the river cages at Sơn Trạch is the fish Phong Nha is known for: firm, and not fishy. It comes steamed, braised, or grilled, and above all as cá trắm kho tiêu, a savory pepper braise served with pickled vegetables.
origin: Sơn Trạch, Bố Trạch, where the fish are raised in cages on the Son River.
culture: A Son River grass-carp contest is held alongside the boat races on the river.
texture: The flesh is firm and not fishy, because the fish feeds in the Son.
taste: Cá trắm kho tiêu is savory, and it comes with pickled vegetables on the side.
howToEat: Order it steamed, braised, or grilled. Cá trắm kho tiêu, braised with pepper and eaten with pickled vegetables, is the one to try first.
where: The cages sit on the Son at Sơn Trạch, in Bố Trạch.
seoTitle: Ca tram song Son — grass carp at Phong Nha
seoDescription: Son River grass carp is steamed, braised, or grilled at Phong Nha, and above all braised with pepper and served with pickled vegetables.
